summary: Rabbi Soffer explains Rashi’s commentary on the verses in Parashat Lech Lecha regarding the prophecy of the future exiles of Bnei Yisrael. He details the calculations for the 400-year period of suffering and discusses the meaning of the fiery vision Avraham Abinu witnessed.
questions: How do we reconcile the 400-year prophecy with the 210 years Bnei Yisrael spent in Mitzrayim?
Why does the Torah count the 400 years starting from the birth of Yitzhak?
What does the vision of the furnace and the torch represent?
How does the placement of the accent mark on a word change its meaning in the Torah?
